Watch Faces changes and customisation: A wide range of watch face selection and customisation available when connecting to the APP.
Sleep: find out the total length of your sleep periods, as well as the deep and light sleep phases you experienced during your last night.
Heart Rate: Measure your heart rate on request or throughout the day (connected and set by the APP)
Workout: choose your sport activity and analyse your data.
Weather: view the weather conditions for the day (available on selected watch faces) 
Notifications: sync your phone's notifications to your connected watch (connected and set by the APP).
Funny Games: Number pairs, 3 to win, Fly a plane and Basketball.
ICE widget: Enter emergency contact information directly from the app to the watch.
And many more... timer, alarm clock, stopwatch, screen brightness, and settings!
